chapterInfo.content:
1
Daa nkwa da adi wɔ Yesu mu
1 # Yoh 1.1; 1.14 Deɛ ɛwɔ hɔ firi mfitiaseɛ, deɛ yɛateɛ, deɛ yɛde yɛn ani ahunu, deɛ yɛhwɛeɛ na yɛde yɛn nsa kaeɛ, wɔ nkwa asɛm no ho, 2#Yoh 1.4 na nkwa no yii ne ho kyerɛe, na yɛahunu, na yɛdi ho adanseɛ, na yɛka daa nkwa a ɛne Agya no wɔ hɔ na ɛyii ne ho kyerɛɛ yɛn no ho asɛm kyerɛ mo, 3deɛ yɛahunu na yɛateɛ no na yɛka kyerɛ mo nso, na mo nso ne yɛn anya ayɔnkofa; na yɛn ayɔnkofa no, yɛne Agya no ne ne Ba Yesu Kristo na ɛwɔ. 4#Yoh 15.11; 16.24 Yɛtwerɛ yeinom brɛ mo, na yɛn anigyeɛ awie pɛyɛ.
Hann mu asetena ne bɔneka
5 # Yak 1.17 Na kaseɛ a yɛtee no ne nkyɛn na yɛbɔ mo yi ne sɛ: Onyankopɔn yɛ hann, na esum biara nni ne mu koraa. 6#1 Yoh 2.4 Sɛ yɛka sɛ yɛne no wɔ ayɔnkofa na yɛnam sum mu a, yɛdi atorɔ, na yɛnnante nokorɛ mu. 7#Heb 9.14; Adi 1.5; 7.14 Na sɛ yɛnam hann mu sɛ ɔno wɔ hann mu no a, na yɛwowɔ ayɔnkofa wɔ yɛn ntɛm, na ne Ba Yesu mogya te yɛn ho firi bɔne nyinaa mu. 8Sɛ yɛka sɛ yɛnni bɔne a, na yɛdaadaa yɛn ho, na nokorɛ no nni yɛn mu. 9#Mmb 28.13 Sɛ yɛka yɛn bɔne kyerɛ a, ɔyɛ nokwafoɔ ne teneneeni sɛ ɔde yɛn bɔne bɛkyɛ yɛn, na wate yɛn ho afiri deɛ ɛntene nyinaa ho. 10Sɛ yɛka sɛ yɛnyɛɛ bɔne a, yɛma no dane ɔtorofoɔ, na n’asɛm no nni yɛn mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Deɛ ɛwɔ hɔ firi mfitiaseɛ, deɛ yɛateɛ, deɛ yɛde yɛn ani ahunu, deɛ yɛhwɛeɛ na yɛde yɛn nsa kaeɛ, wɔ nkwa asɛm no ho, na nkwa no yii ne ho kyerɛe, na yɛahunu, na yɛdi ho adanseɛ, na yɛka daa nkwa a ɛne Agya no wɔ hɔ na ɛyii ne ho kyerɛɛ yɛn no ho asɛm kyerɛ mo, deɛ yɛahunu na yɛateɛ no na yɛka kyerɛ mo nso, na mo nso ne yɛn anya ayɔnkofa; na yɛn ayɔnkofa no, yɛne Agya no ne ne Ba Yesu Kristo na ɛwɔ. Yɛtwerɛ yeinom brɛ mo, na yɛn anigyeɛ awie pɛyɛ.

Na kaseɛ a yɛtee no ne nkyɛn na yɛbɔ mo yi ne sɛ: Onyankopɔn yɛ hann, na esum biara nni ne mu koraa. Sɛ yɛka sɛ yɛne no wɔ ayɔnkofa na yɛnam sum mu a, yɛdi atorɔ, na yɛnnante nokorɛ mu. Na sɛ yɛnam hann mu sɛ ɔno wɔ hann mu no a, na yɛwowɔ ayɔnkofa wɔ yɛn ntɛm, na ne Ba Yesu mogya te yɛn ho firi bɔne nyinaa mu. Sɛ yɛka sɛ yɛnni bɔne a, na yɛdaadaa yɛn ho, na nokorɛ no nni yɛn mu. Sɛ yɛka yɛn bɔne kyerɛ a, ɔyɛ nokwafoɔ ne teneneeni sɛ ɔde yɛn bɔne bɛkyɛ yɛn, na wate yɛn ho afiri deɛ ɛntene nyinaa ho. Sɛ yɛka sɛ yɛnyɛɛ bɔne a, yɛma no dane ɔtorofoɔ, na n’asɛm no nni yɛn mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
